decisions.reason: As a very recent launch with its own webpage and a close fit to the firm's door business, management is likely to stay committed absent clear evidence of failure.
Although only mentioned on the website, it is still a fresh product in the firm's core garage-door line, so sunk development effort and the chance of temporary market effects favor retention.
This operator variant extends the firm's established offering, and with only a short time on the market management would likely justify prior investment by keeping it for longer.
The product sits squarely in the industrial sectional door range, and despite only modest website visibility the firm is likely to continue rather than reverse a recent commitment.
As an insulated variant within the same strategic product family, it benefits from the firm's broader commitment to the line and is unlikely to be withdrawn so soon.
Because it had a page of its own and belongs to a central product category for the firm, management would be especially prone to continue backing it within the next year.
